Calling Syrian Artists: a residency in London

With Delfina Foundation and Madad Art Foundation, we opened a residency for Syrian artists.

Open call · Dec 2025

We support Delfina Foundation's open call for Syrian artists: a residency in London that gives artists time and space for research and creation, run with Madad Art Foundation.

To make the call open to as many artists as possible, Delfina Foundation held two online info sessions in English and Arabic, including an extended Q&A with Sarah Rambourg.

The first artist selected, Ranim AlHalaky, joined the winter 2026 residency. Follow Delfina Foundation and our Instagram for the next call.
